VBO:0201343.summary: Spirited and energetic, terriers often bring a determined, sometimes stubborn character to their work. Many were developed to hunt vermin and watch homes or barns, with breeds ranging from the small Cairn to the larger Airedale. The Border Terrier adds an affectionate side to that working heritage; its ancestors ran with foxhounds along the English–Scottish border.
VBO:0201343.shortDescription: Often energetic and strong-willed, terriers bring a vermin-hunting heritage shared by small earth dogs and larger workers.
